findings.body:
**Disable hooks on the private-index import.**

The `update-index --index-info` call at `src/ops/dev/internal/snapshot.ts:239` omits the `-c core.hooksPath=/dev/null` and `-c core.fsmonitor=false` overrides. Every other Git invocation in `captureWorkingTree` passes them. The call uses the shared `env`, which sets `GIT_INDEX_FILE` but does not disable hooks. Git writes the index for this command, so a configured `post-index-change` hook can run. That hook can rewrite tracked files in the author's working tree or change refs. The capture then reads the altered files, so the snapshot may not match the author's working tree.

Add the same overrides used by the helper:

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-        ['--no-replace-objects', 'update-index', '-z', '--index-info'],
+        [
+          '--no-replace-objects',
+          '-c',
+          'core.hooksPath=/dev/null',
+          '-c',
+          'core.fsmonitor=false',
+          'update-index',
+          '-z',
+          '--index-info',
+        ],
```

</details>
findings.title: Disable hooks on the private-index import.
